title: Aureline M5 AI policy result
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for an AI review policy result — the typed outcome an AI review run inherits from the governing review pack. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the AI run's bound pack version and digest, the result binding (analyzer result class — full versus experimental versus policy-downgraded, the pack-version-and-digest binding the run resolved through, or the rerun/staleness relationship a prior finding holds after the pack changed), the analyzer result class, and the rerun relationship so an AI result never reads as current, full, pack-compliant evidence when it actually ran with a narrower analyzer set, under a divergent pack version, or before a pack change that has since invalidated it. Downstream the AI review panel, review detail, publish-to-review sheets, provider handoff, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating an AI result state by hand. Raw prompts, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
